name: Moody Rabbit 65
author: vinodjangid07
description: Pill indigo toggle switch that toggles on and off when clicked.
howItWorks: Clicking it toggles it: transform becomes translateX(100%), background-color changes from #525252 to #ffffff, background-color changes from #525252 to #9476ff.
combined:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Moody Rabbit 65</title>
<style>
/* Moody Rabbit 65 by vinodjangid07 — https://uiverse.io/vinodjangid07/moody-rabbit-65 */
#checkboxInput {
  display: none;
}

.toggleSwitch {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  position: relative;
  width: 50px;
  height: 30px;
  background-color: rgb(82, 82, 82);
  border-radius: 20px;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition-duration: .2s;
}

.toggleSwitch::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  height: 10px;
  width: 10px;
  left: 5px;
  background-color: transparent;
  border-radius: 50%;
  transition-duration: .2s;
  box-shadow: 5px 2px 7px rgba(8, 8, 8, 0.26);
  border: 5px solid white;
}

#checkboxInput:checked+.toggleSwitch::after {
  transform: translateX(100%);
  transition-duration: .2s;
  background-color: white;
}

#checkboxInput:checked+.toggleSwitch {
  background-color: rgb(148, 118, 255);
  transition-duration: .2s;
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<input type="checkbox" id="checkboxInput">
    <label for="checkboxInput" class="toggleSwitch">
    </label>

</body>
</html>
